subtitle: Only words attached to your Tail are validated. Wrong letters block your word.
helpText:
• Move the snake using Arrows, WASD, or swipe gestures.
  • Eat tiles to add letters to your tail.
  • Form valid words of 3 or more letters ending at the tip of your tail.
  • Press Space (or Submit button) to cash in your word for points and reduce your size.
  • If you eat a wrong letter, it blocks your word. You must use that wrong letter to form a new word to free yourself!
  • Points Calculation:
    • +1 pt for every tile eaten.
    • Each letter has a base value when submitting a word.
    • The multiplier cells on the board apply if you place your letters over them when submitting. They affect specific letters (x2 L, x3 L) or the entire word (x2 W, x3 W).
    • The total score is multiplied by the word's length (e.g. 4 letters = x2, 5 letters = x3).
  • Local Dictionaries: English (274k), Spanish (636k), French (336k), Galician (687k), Catalan (891k), and Basque (864k) validated words.

privacyText:
By saving your score globally, you agree to the following:

  • A unique anonymous token will be generated on your device to update your record without requesting personal data.
  • Your alias will be evaluated by Google's Gemini AI to ensure an offense-free environment.
  • Your alias and score will be public and visible to all players on the leaderboard.
